about: SAMPLE. These figures are invented for the example house of the skill. In a real project this file is the hand-written transcription of every dimension, level and name printed on the original documents: the CAD sheets draw these values as documented dimensions and the build fails if the model disagrees with them. Nothing here may be measured from an image or estimated.
